authorization: User: follow your plan continue the research to produce usable forecasting

decision.gap_limit_caveat: Necessary operational bound, not proof of completeness; require uncapped, scope-valid reconciliation and documented counting semantics
decision.input_available_by: t, using durable local receipt time; no post-t information
decision.issued_by: t+30 seconds; log late computation as missed, never backdate
decision.news_readiness: original release and defensible evidence link durably available by t; record unknown novelty/direction instead of inventing them
decision.same_timestamp: abstain if prices differ at a sampled minute and source-consistent execution order is unresolved
decision.status: authenticated current mapping/rules and accepting-orders status received by t, at most120s old; scheduled end alone is insufficient
decision.warmup: 241 seeded minute prices ending at t; no unresolved receipt gaps in the four-hour input interval

endpoint.late_backfill: diagnostic only; never repair the primary endpoint after its deadline
endpoint.missing: retain issued forecast, mark outcome unavailable with reason; never silently remove from coverage denominator
endpoint.selection: latest unambiguous canonical YES execution at or before target among receipts durable by target+120s
endpoint.status: resolution/status evidence covers decision through target, with no unresolved gap >120s; conflicting or incomplete evidence makes outcome unavailable

measurement_choices: 300s freshness inherited;120s receipt/status bounds and30s emission budget are new operational design choices, not optimized or empirically validated thresholds
scope: Prospective feasibility and staged shadow forecasting; not confirmation, trading, or a replacement of earlier studies
source_convention: unselected; provider/direct compatibility review must precede activation
stages: Record source-feasibility dossiers; model scoring stays disabled.
One full prospective episode observation passes all decision and endpoint gates, plus feature/source compatibility.
Freeze an activation receipt for later five-minute grids; do not score the first observation retrospectively as a live forecast.
Issue fixed-model shadow probabilities and abstentions before outcomes; append outcomes separately.
Freeze comparator artifacts, unseen evaluation window and dependence-aware analysis before a confirmatory comparison.
